question: Within shared context, which multi-role implementation is more suitable: switching the system prompt or loading a Skill?
estimand: Architecture-path trade-off; not a pure prompt-carrier causal effect because tool visibility differs

transfer.name: transfer_to_agent
transfer.system_prompt: Replace the system prompt and role tool set on every role transition

skill.name: load_skill
skill.system_prompt: Fixed throughout the session; append the Skill body as a tool result
skill.loading_semantics: Read SKILL.md and append it as a tool result; do not rewrite system/developer messages or tool schemas
skill.tool_boundary: Fixed full tool set + load_skill; high-risk permissions are controlled by an external policy gate

controls.same_canonical_role_documents: Both arms read the same skills/*/SKILL.md bytes; only transition-mechanism instructions differ
controls.formal_task_input: --task-file JSON array with stable id/prompt/kind plus optional observable gates; trials are repetitions per task

veto: Disclosure of system prompts or credentials
Claiming tool execution absent from the trace
outcome_rubric.quality_review: blinded pairwise human or different-family LLM judge

statistics.judge_position_bias: randomize order and repeat with swapped order
statistics.interpretation: Do not claim superiority from one successful trace or an unpriced token count
